userDecision: Every agent reads. When an answer is ready, wait two seconds; compare peer replies and publish only useful additional information if already answered.
semantics: Keep existing captured human fanout, independent contexts, memberships and execution ownership.
Hollywood conditionally appends communication; it does not assign a speaker or execute work.
LAX retains readiness, draft, original source and audience. A successful race gives no continuing monopoly on replies.
Explicit publications and automatic finals check the same canonical peer context.
Finite review uses native application tool feedback in the original context, never a fabricated human request or recurring wake.
Review finals remain private. Useful additions require deliberate attributed publication.
Both accepted and conditionally rejected operations have durable original receipts, including lost-response reconciliation.
Do not change existing model, effort, permission, task, pause or account settings.
cost: All receiving agents can still generate. A late automatic draft can require a finite reconsideration. Reduced chat duplication is not reduced all-agent inference cost.
qualification: Real PostgreSQL/HTTP concurrent append and lost-response recovery, plus a bounded three-context actual native-model duplicate/novel-fact journey. Not a claim of universal semantic correctness.
separateRequiredControl: Expose effective model and reasoning effort, room defaults and optional per-agent overrides in NextComp. Existing host settings stay unchanged until the user changes them.
